{{Quote|Attention all viewers. Due to suspected Rebel activity on the Kazzook ''[sic]'' planet, the Empire has declared martial law.|The unidentified officer|<ref name="SWHS" />}}
An '''officer''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] made announcements regarding [[Planet/Legends|interplanetar]] travel restrictions and curfews. He was also responsible for broadcasting instructions and requests for communication to Imperial patrols via common [[wallscreen]]s. His [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia]] indicated he was a [[High General]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] on the wallscreen was played by [[Claude Woolman]] in [[1978]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.
